description: Render App Store and Google Play screenshots from screens (layout JSON) and image files. Returns a jobId for keyed/async renders or a download link for anonymous/inline renders.

files.description: Image files; each item is an object {name, path} or {name, base64}, carrying exactly one of path or base64.

base64.description: Inline base64 image bytes; only for tiny synthetic test images.

name.description: File name, as the AppScreen API should know the image.

path.description: A local file path; the server reads the bytes off disk and encodes them (a leading ~/ expands to the home directory).

screens.description: Screen layouts as JSON objects; structure is defined by the AppScreen API and passed through opaquely.

name: render_screenshots
